title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: SharePoint list agent creates Microsoft Lists from prompts
notes: claim 38: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The feature description, roadmap details and both blocking controls are supported. The statement that Microsoft has not described rollout mechanics overlooks the cited release notes' deployment explanation; licensing also understates the published product-level requirement, and the promise of no admin-console changes lacks evidence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; summary; Cost and licensing; changes
claims.claim: No agent-specific licence is published, so the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace 'Licensing for this agent is not yet published' and equivalent unqualified statements with 'Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government and education subscription plans; no additional licence specific to the SharePoint list agent is published.' Keep the existing licence-options citation. This records the general product entitlement without claiming a separate agent licence.
